scripts.build: npm run build-all && npm run consolidate
scripts.build-all: npm run build-aca && npm run build-channie && npm run build-cissi && npm run build-piya
scripts.build-aca: cd "aca card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-channie: cd "channie card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-cissi: cd "cissi card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-piya: cd "piya card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.consolidate: shx rm -rf public && shx mkdir -p public/images public/aca-card public/channie-card public/cissi-card public/piya-card && shx cp index.html style.css logo.webp public/ && shx cp "aca card/public/aca.webp" "channie card/public/channie.webp" "cissi card/public/cissi.webp" "piya card/src/assets/piya.webp" public/images/ && shx cp -r "aca card/dist/"* public/aca-card/ && shx cp -r "channie card/dist/"* public/channie-card/ && shx cp -r "cissi card/dist/"* public/cissi-card/ && shx cp -r "piya card/dist/"* public/piya-card/
